page.overview:
What is Desert Town?

Desert Town is a location in Final Fantasy Legend II. The player can get into random encounters while walking around town.

Talking to the bartender of the cafe will reveal that Ashura's Tower is hidden in the sandstorm. He tells the party to go seven steps to the east and seven steps to the south of the cactus located directly south of town. When the player sees a cactus at the end, the tower will be directly south from it.
